▪ Core Capital/Risk Weighted Assets-The bank is reviewing its Credit Risk Weighted Assets to manage the risk weighted assets
optimally.
▪ Total Capital/Risk Weighted Assets Closed at 16.1% on account of growth in Credit risk weighted Assets. Still above the
Minimum Statutory ratio of 14.5%.
▪ Core Capital/Total Deposits Closed at 20% on account of growth in Credit risk weighted Assets. Still above the Minimum
Statutory ratio of 10.5%.
